summary: The runeforge-docs site has strong documentation structure but faces mobile usability issues (horizontal overflow, small tap targets, missing input labels) and incomplete feature exploration (only 9% of interactive features exercised). Key pages like quickstart, stores, and API reference were tested, but many interactive elements (e.g., <Provider />, API, Blog links) remain untested.

issues.problem: Horizontal overflow on mobile (page width 536px > viewport 390px) causes content to be cut off or require horizontal scrolling, reducing readability.
issues.evidence: Layout warnings in mobile viewports (e.g., guide-quickstart.html, guide-stores.html) show page width exceeds viewport width. Visible text in mobile screenshots confirms horizontal overflow.
issues.suggested_fix: Implement responsive design fixes (e.g., fluid layouts, breakpoints) to ensure content fits within mobile viewports without horizontal overflow.

issues.problem: Small tap targets (e.g., 'Runeforge v3.4' 152x25px, '☾' 30x27px) violate mobile guidance (44px minimum), increasing tap error rates.
issues.evidence: Layout warnings in mobile viewports identify small tap targets. Bounding box data (e.g., 152x25px, 30x27px) confirms targets are below 44px.
issues.suggested_fix: Increase tap target sizes (e.g., expand 'Runeforge v3.4' link, adjust theme toggle button) to meet 44px minimum height/width.

issues.problem: The version selector <select> element has no visible label, aria-label, or placeholder, violating accessibility standards.
issues.evidence: Layout warnings in mobile viewports (e.g., guide-stores.html) flag a missing input label. The <select> element’s DOM summary confirms no label.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a visible label, aria-label, or placeholder to the version selector to clarify its purpose.

issues.problem: Only 9% of interactive features (e.g., <Provider />, API, Blog links) were exercised, leaving critical documentation and navigation paths untested.
issues.evidence: Coverage data shows 20/219 features exercised (9%). Unexplored features include <Provider />, API, Blog, and Community links.
issues.suggested_fix: Systematically test remaining interactive elements (e.g., <Provider /> section, API/Blog links) to ensure completeness and fix any issues.

issues.problem: The 'Examples' page’s 'Intermediate' filter initially failed to update the example list, causing confusion about filtering functionality.
issues.evidence: Testing the 'Intermediate' button showed no immediate update; scrolling revealed filtered content later, indicating delayed or unclear feedback.
issues.suggested_fix: Fix the 'Intermediate' filter to update the example list immediately on click, with visual feedback (e.g., loading indicator, updated counts).

issues.problem: Small tap targets for navigation links (e.g., 'Actions & selectors' 326x29px) violate mobile guidance, increasing tap errors.
issues.evidence: Layout warnings in mobile viewports identify small tap targets for navigation links. Bounding box data (326x29px) confirms targets are below 44px.
issues.suggested_fix: Increase navigation link sizes (e.g., adjust padding) to meet 44px minimum tap target size.
